item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00137","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C13","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. Both orders use the same two-paragraph form and nearly identical operative syntax to suspend provisions of Title III of the Officer Personnel Act concerning Marine Corps service-in-grade requirements and eligibility for temporary promotion. The child adapts C15 by changing the covered grades from first lieutenant and captain to brigadier general, specifying promotion to major general, changing the suspension endpoint, and replacing the supersession clause with an effective-date clause. C13 and C22 share the same statutory suspension machinery and emergency-based endpoint, but their covered promotion provisions are broader and their language is less precisely aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The operation of those provisions of Title III of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947, as amended, which relate to the service-in-grade requirements of officers of the Marine Corps of the grade of brigadier general for eligibility for consideration by a selection board for temporary promotion to the grade of major general is hereby suspended","parent_excerpt":"The operation of those provisions of Title III of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947, as amended, which relate to the service-in-grade requirements of officers of the Marine Corps of the grades of first lieutenant and captain for eligibility for consideration for temporary promotion to the next higher grade is hereby suspended","explanation":"This is distinctive, extensive shared language implementing the same legal mechanism; the child substitutes a different Marine Corps grade and promotion target."},{"child_excerpt":"until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end","parent_excerpt":"until June 30, 1957","explanation":"The child retains C15's suspension structure but adapts its expiration condition using the emergency-linked endpoint also present in C13 and C22."},{"child_excerpt":"2. This order shall become effective on July 1, 1955.","parent_excerpt":"2. This order supersedes [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of June 30, 1953","explanation":"Both use a compact numbered second paragraph for an administrative consequence, though its particular function changes from supersession to effective date."}]}
